kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعاهد (form VI)
# نَتَعَاهَدُ (nataʕāhadu) /na.ta.ʕaː.ha.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# نُتَعَاهَدُ (nutaʕāhadu) /nu.ta.ʕaː.ha.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# نَتَعَاهَدَ (nataʕāhada) /na.ta.ʕaː.ha.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# نُتَعَاهَدَ (nutaʕāhada) /nu
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
